messages:
Amanda: FYI Solaris (customer) reporting 503s hitting Dedicated pool-5 since ~09:10 UTC. CS says failures on /generate and p95 latency spiking. SLA at risk. Can oncall confirm? Ticket SOL-447.
SRE-Bot: Alert: pool-5 error rate > 5% over 5m. Autoscaler tried x3 scale attempts and failed (quota).
Mike: Oncall here — looking. Any recent deploys to pool-5? Do we have a quick repro or sample request id from the CS logs?
Jen: No deploys since yesterday. I pulled logs from g-5-12 and seeing repeated KV cache OOMs + GC spikes. Tail:
```
09:09:52 ERROR runtime.kvcache: eviction failed, OOM
09:09:53 WARN runtime.gc: pause 720ms
```
Paul: I'm runtime-config owner — we pushed a config tweak last week that reduced kv_cache.size to lower mem tail for small models. Reverting that change now. PR: https://git.internal/rw/runtime-configs/pull/824
Tanya: If rollback doesn't drop errors quickly I can hotpatch nodes with forced cache flush and restart. Have script ready, ping me and I'll run it. @DevOps-Bot will help with node rotation.
DevOps-Bot: Initiated replacement of g-5-12 -> draining, cordon, new instance provisioning. Estimated replacement ETA 12m.
Mike: Good. Amanda please tell CS we have an active rollback + node rotation in flight. I'll own customer comms for now and post ETA to the ticket.
Amanda: Pinged CS with a brief: "We see runtime OOMs causing 503s; rollback + node rotation in progress; ETA ~20m. Using fallback routing if required." They asked whether we expect a full failover to a different pool.
Paul: If rollback succeeds within 20m we won't need failover. If not, plan B is to route Solaris traffic to pool-7 (model-compatible) as a temporary fallback; I can coordinate the routing switch and capacity checks. Will update in 20.
Jen: Rollback applied to 3 of 5 nodes so far. Errors trending down to ~1.2% from 6.3%. Monitoring p95 and error rate.
Mike: Owners for this thread: Paul (runtime config/rollback), Jen (observability/metrics), Tanya (hotpatch ready), Mike (oncall/customer comms). Document owners on SOL-447 and add follow-up postmortem owner.
Leo: small ask — please add postmortem owners and action items to the ticket now so CS has a clear SLA remediation plan.
Amanda: Updating SOL-447 with timeline, owner list, and temporary fallback plan. Will close loop after we confirm stability. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
